listing.name: Super Smash Bros. Melee — GD's Melee (GurekamDhillon)
listing.summary: This public beta offers rollback, modding and Lua features. Full compatibility has not been confirmed. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own NTSC-USA GALE01 revision 1.02 disc. Permitted modified discs also need the exact baseline required by upstream.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the v0.3.0 launcher and release instructions to build or import your own data. Source builds have separate dependency instructions.

warnings: This public beta offers rollback, modding and Lua features. Full compatibility has not been confirmed.
